_method: Fresh general-purpose agent per prompt, 2026-11-19. The agent saw ONLY the skill name + frontmatter description (mirroring description-based routing) and one user prompt; it was not told the expected answer and had no file access. First sentence forced to a binary decision. p01's first attempt was killed by a platform concurrency limit and re-run with a fresh agent; the retry result is recorded.
_scope: One sample per prompt, single model family (same as the orchestrating agent), platform-default sampling. This is an automated trigger smoke test, not a replication-grade study; broader models and repeated samples belong to the manual protocol in tests/evaluation/README.md.
